purpose: Assemble frozen E1 Batch 01-08 first-pass event rows and run source traceability plus content-only semantic-consistency QA before E1 event freeze. The gate may flag rows, but may not mutate event data or inspect local 1-5y pairability.
semantic_review_triggers: eligible COMPETITIVE negative row contains draw/tie in event text
eligible STATUS negative row uses resignation/removal/collapse/disqualification mechanism requiring policy-consistency check
eligible PROJECT positive row appears to be lifetime/honorary/general-career recognition rather than a discrete project outcome
same subject-year contains both eligible positive and negative polarity; retained but reviewed for same-event double coding
forbidden: delete an event because it hurts pairability
pass_rule: E1 event freeze remains blocked until every eligible source-review row and every eligible semantic-review row has an immutable manual resolution. Review resolution may confirm a row, mark an already-excluded row as audit-only, or identify an objective event-field correction; any correction requires a separately hashed correction file before freeze.
